newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: VA Tech repeats 96 earnings rise up on 95.
newsitem.headline: VA Tech repeats 96 earnings rise up on 95.

text.p: Austrian engineering group VA Technologie AG should achieve bigger growth in pre-tax profit and sales this year than in 1995, chief executive Otmar Puehringer repeated on Friday.
"There will be a double digit (percentage) increase in turnover and (pre-tax) earnings...Growth will be above last year," he told journalists.
In 1995, VA Tech reported a 13 percent jump in pre-tax profit to 1.27 billion schillings.
Earlier VA Tech said its nine-month order backlog rose to 80 billion schillings from 71.68 billion at the end of last year. -- Vienna Newsroom, 43-1-53112-258
